thread:
Paul G: FYI - noticed a spike in daily charges for a subset of customers tied to AlloyHardware. looks like the same physical device SKUs were reported under two different SKU IDs this morning (old_alias + canonical). that caused double-counting in the rollup.

Marcos Ops: saw the anomaly in shard 4. diffs show duplicate (device_serial, day) pairs with sku=ALLOY-PRO and sku=ALLOY-PRO-v2. both map to the same ratecard.

billing-bot: ingest alert: duplicate sku alias detected for partner alloyhardware at 2026-09-14T08:12:03Z - duplicate_count=182

Anika (partner-eng): quick background: Alloy rolled out a SKU rename during their region cutover. their collector emitted both the old_alias and the new canonical sku for a short window while migrating mappings. they thought downstream would canonicalize but we treat each sku as distinct.

CS Lead: any customer visible impact?

Marcos Ops: preliminary scan: 72 accounts had overcount > $0.10, 9 accounts > $25. ledger currently has the summed value (counts both SKUs).

Paul G: can someone paste 2 sample events (redacted) that show the double-report pattern?

Marcos Ops: samples below:
```json
{"event_id":"evt_A_9001","device_serial":"AH-0001","partner_id":"alloy","sku":"ALLOY-PRO","units":10,"timestamp":"2026-09-14T07:59:58Z"}
{"event_id":"evt_B_9002","device_serial":"AH-0001","partner_id":"alloy","sku":"ALLOY-PRO-v2","units":10,"timestamp":"2026-09-14T07:59:59Z"}
```
(note: different event_id but same device_serial + near identical timestamps)

Anika (partner-eng): confirming - their migration flow did an in-flight remap and emitted both records for safety. they can produce a canonicalization manifest that declares ALLOY-PRO-v2 -> ALLOY-PRO with an effective_ts.

Paul G: plan proposal:
- 1) run a normalization pass that collapses alias SKUs to canonical SKU using partner-provided mapping and effective timestamp window
- 2) de-dupe records post-normalization by (device_serial, timestamp_bucket, canonical_sku) keeping last-write by event_ts
- 3) recompute entitlements and generate reconciliation batch with deltas
- 4) apply consumer credits for negative deltas > $50 after CS review
- 5) require partner contract update: any SKU remap must be accompanied by signed manifest and 24h pre-notice

billing-bot: created reconciliation batch rec_3765439876_01 with 182 affected events.

Anika (partner-eng): sample manifest we'll send (will be signed):
```json
{
  "partner_id":"alloy",
  "mapping": [
    {"from":"ALLOY-PRO-v2","to":"ALLOY-PRO","effective_from":"2026-09-14T07:59:00Z"}
  ],
  "batch_id":"alloy_map_20260914_v1"
}
```

Marcos Ops: technical note: normalization should only apply when event_ts >= effective_from and <= effective_from + 10m to limit blast radius. also we need to ensure idempotency: store mapping_batch_id on events so replays don't flip-flop.

Legal: we need the signed manifest and a short liability clause for remap-induced corrections. we cannot accept unsigned retroactive mappings for monetary adjustments.

CS Lead: I'll prepare outreach draft for the 9 customers flagged > $25. prefer manual review before auto-credits.

Paul G: timeline?

Marcos Ops: can run normalization + de-dupe now; estimate 40m for shard 4. recompute and generate deltas ~1h. I'll gate ledger-apply until CS thumbs up on high-value items.

Anika (partner-eng): partner will post signed mapping manifest to /partners/mappings with header X-Signature and idempotency_id=alloy_map_20260914_v1 by 2026-09-14T09:00Z. they will also update collector to stop dual-emitting.

billing-bot: normalization job started for shard 4 at 2026-09-14T08:25:00Z. progress logged to /runs/3765439876-normalize.log

Paul G: thanks. follow-ups for docs: (a) add SKU remap runbook with manifest schema and time-window rules, (b) add contract bullet requiring 24h notice + signed manifest for remaps, (c) add a postmortem template entry for mid-rollout mapping changes. tagging @Legal and @partner-eng for sign-off. :white_check_mark:
